units.source_text: 源氏公子在须磨的住处，
就在从前流放于此而吟“寂寞度残生”的行平中纳言的住处附近。

en.t: was near the residence of Middle Counselor Yukihira, who had once been exiled there and composed a poem about spending the rest of his life in loneliness.

units.source_text: 其地离海岸稍远，是幽静而荒凉的山中。

en.t: The place lay a little way back from the shore, in quiet, desolate mountains.

units.source_text: 自墙垣以至种种建设，均甚别致，与京中绝不相同。

en.t: From the walls to the various buildings, everything had an unusual charm and was utterly unlike anything in the capital.

units.source_text: 有茅葺的屋及芦苇编的亭子，建筑形式别有雅趣，与环境颇为调和。

en.t: There were thatched houses and pavilions woven of reeds; the style of the buildings had a special elegance and harmonized well with the surroundings.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“此地与京中完全异趣，倘我不是流放而来此，倒很有趣味呢。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "This place is entirely different in character from the capital; if I had not come here in exile, I would find it rather delightful."

units.source_text: 他便回想起以前种种浪漫行为来。

en.t: He then began to recall his many romantic exploits from the past.
